description: This file declares functions and structures related to an interactive rebase feature, including managing a TODO list during rebase operations.

methods.name: append_todo_help
methods.description: Appends help information for the TODO list commands, including command count and revision range details.

methods.name: edit_todo_list
methods.description: Allows editing of the TODO list for a repository, considering current options and revisions.

methods.name: todo_list_check
methods.description: Checks the validity or consistency of a TODO list.

methods.name: todo_list_check_against_backup
methods.description: Compares the current TODO list against a backup for consistency.
